title: CrestApps Learning configuration
description: The settings of the Learning module read from appsettings.json, in the OrchardCore section of the host or a tenant.

Media.description: The media limits Learning sets on Orchard Core Media for lesson files and videos. They are the tenant's media limits.

MaxFileSize.description: The largest media file in bytes. Media's own limit is kept when it is larger; zero leaves Media's limit alone.

AdditionalFileExtensions.description: File extensions added to the ones Media takes. Programs, scripts, web pages and macro-enabled Office files are never added.

MaxFilesPerSubmission.description: The most files an author may let a learner hand in at once.

MaxFileSizeMb.description: The largest file, in megabytes, an author may let a learner hand in.

Upkeep.description: The daily Learning upkeep: reminders and inactive learners.

AccessEndingNoticeDays.description: How many days before access ends the access-ending notice is raised. Zero turns it off.

InactiveDays.description: After how many days without activity a learner counts as inactive. Zero turns it off.

DueSoonDays.description: How many days before the due date the due-soon notice is raised. Zero turns it off.
